policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: The goals are pooled at the top of the chart, not spread through it: Rollins alone have outscored Eckerd, Florida Tech, Barry, Nova Southeastern and Saint Leo put together.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Rollins have conceded more goals than any other side in the conference and have still not lost.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: The record now carries one score gap: Nova Southeastern's home match against Florida Memorial has a final and no published score. Three more matches have passed their date with no result at all, and all three are Palm Beach Atlantic's, among them the match against Barry, a fellow member.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Palm Beach Atlantic have yet to lose and have won only once; the draws at home to Carson-Newman and away at Young Harris account for the rest.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Six different players have scored for Embry-Riddle in wins over Trinity of Jacksonville and Georgia Southwestern, the widest spread of scorers in the conference.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Kobi Thomas has scored three of Palm Beach Atlantic's five goals, from thirteen shots.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Henry Obi has made twelve saves in two defeats for Barry and conceded five.
